measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark, BEHONEST, is designed to assess honesty in LLMs across three dimensions: self-knowledge (awareness of knowledge boundaries), non-deceptiveness (avoidance of deceit), and consistency in responses.
